stem:
The graph shows the cost to rent a surfboard for different amounts of time.

Which list best represents the independent values of the graphed points?
visual_elements: Graph with y-axis labeled 'Cost (dollars)' from 0 to 45 and x-axis labeled 'Amount of Time (hours)' from 0 to 7, showing points at (1, 7.5), (2, 15), (3, 22.5), (4, 30), (5, 37.5), (6, 45)
